items.summary: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
items.recommend_reason_zh: pbakaus/impeccable 为编码代理提供一套设计词汇，用 polish、bolder 调整方向，用 critique、audit 审查，在发布前拦下 AI 生成的粗糙设计。
items.recommend_reason_en: pbakaus/impeccable provides a design vocabulary for coding agents so you can steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, and catch AI slop before it ships, making it worth opening today.

items.summary: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.
items.recommend_reason_zh: Radar让agent自己带上Radar、不必依赖AI SRE；想了解它具体怎么用，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Radar is presented as something to give your agent instead of an AI SRE, so it is worth opening to see how that substitution is meant to work.

items.summary: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use

items.recommend_reason_en: milind-soni/OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use, making it worth opening to explore how bots can operate in a VM.

items.summary: GitHub and Linear issues, right inside your Codex

items.recommend_reason_en: Arco brings GitHub and Linear issues directly inside your Codex, which makes it worth opening if you want issue context alongside your coding workflow.
